artworks.title: The Sacrifice of Iphigenia
artworks.description: Tiepolo's Aulis — the becalmed muster, Calchas' oracle, and the price Artemis demanded before the Cypria's fleet could sail for Troy.

artworks.title: Achilles and Telephus
artworks.description: Spranger's healing scene — the Mysian detour where the spear that wounded Telephus scraped rust to guide the host to the true Troad.
